messages:
Lina (Design): Drafting a small RFC for sidebar IA changes: move from resource-type groups to task-oriented groups (Models | Serving | Ops), add shallow breadcrumb support and canonical path routing for shareable links. I sketched two alternatives in Figma, linking below. Thoughts?

Hector (Product): Task-oriented groups feel more discoverable for new users. One ask: expose API Keys and Secrets under Ops top-level so SREs don't have to dig. Also, how will this affect the Console perm matrix?

Devon (Frontend): Implementation notes: switching to canonical paths makes deep links nicer but breaks old `#/` links users have bookmarked. We can add a small client shim + server redirects. Example fallback snippet:```
// migrate legacy hash links
if (location.hash.startsWith('#/')) {
  const newPath = '/console' + location.hash.slice(1);
  history.replaceState(null, '', newPath);
}
```
We'll gate the change behind a feature flag `console_nav_reorg_v1`.

Nora (Platform): FYI: some enterprise IdPs embed relay state in the fragment. If we repurpose fragments we must support relay passthrough or add SAML-specific exceptions. Add SAML cases to test matrix.

Kai (Accessibility): A couple of a11y details: when a route changes programmatically, focus must be set to the page heading or the breadcrumb (`role=navigation aria-label="Breadcrumbs"`) so keyboard users know context changed. Side-nav active items should use `aria-current="true"` and not rely on color alone. Also ensure contrast for the selected state on small screens.

Lina (Design): Good points. I'll update the Figma variants to show keyboard focus styles and the Ops > API Keys placement. Also proposing a compact breadcrumb that shows 3 segments max with an overflow menu for long paths.

Marcos (Research): Can we add instrumentation before the rollout? Track `nav_interaction` with `origin` and `target_path`, and `deep_link_open` + `referrer_host`. We want to see if people actually paste links into Slack/email.

Hector (Product): Also suggest a shortlink service for long log URLs: `/x/:short` expands server-side to the full path. Makes sharing in tickets much nicer.

Devon (Frontend): Shortlink is doable. Plan: 1) server redirector for legacy hashes + shortlinks, 2) client shim + router switch behind flag, 3) a11y attributes + focus management, 4) analytics hooks. Staging checklist: legacy link tests, keyboard nav, SAML IdP flows, shortlink resolution, mobile expand/collapse.

Lina (Design): Rollout suggestion: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 weeks with monitor signals for 404s, nav_click failure, and a11y regressions (keyboard focus lost). I'll add that to the PR description. Who can pair on the SAML test cases? @Nora?

Nora (Platform): I'll own SAML tests and add them to the CI matrix. Will also coordinate with infra to ensure logs capture redirect errors.
